conversation.content: My VPN keeps disconnecting every few minutes

Hello! I'm a general support agent and I'll do my best to help based on my general knowledge. Feel free to ask follow-up questions at any time. If your issue is resolved you can ask to close the ticket, or escalate if you need further human assistance.

Frequent VPN disconnections are often caused by an unstable internet connection, an outdated VPN client, or a misconfigured idle timeout setting. Try restarting your VPN client and checking for updates.
Please escalate this to a network specialist
